recipe.visualDefinition: A vibrant, multi-layered graphic composition featuring a stylized amusement park scene at night, characterized by a large undulating roller coaster track that divides the frame, contrasting flat color fields with detailed line-art illustrations and a circular portrait inset.
coreVisualRelationships: The roller coaster track acts as a dynamic horizon line separating the sky from the fairground.
The circular portrait inset balances the large typographic elements in the upper half.
Wavy color bands (green, yellow, white) create a sense of motion following the track's curve.
Dense, dark crowd silhouettes at the bottom anchor the lighter, more open sky area.
coreInvariants: Undulating diagonal division of the frame
High-contrast black line-art over colored backgrounds
Circular portrait frame with concentric rings
Combination of script and heavy slab-serif lettering

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The amusement park occupies the bottom half; the artist name and portrait occupy the top half; the title is centered along the roller coaster curve.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The circular portrait in the upper right and the Ferris wheel in the lower right.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes follow the script name from top left, down the roller coaster track through the title, to the Ferris wheel at the bottom right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The solid blue sky provides breathing room for the script lettering and portrait.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Sky Blue (background) and Deep Purple (fairground shadow)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Acid Green and Bright Yellow (wavy bands and light glows)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the color bands against a muted, slightly desaturated blue sky and dark purple ground.
paletteRestrictions: Limited to 5-6 primary ink colors to simulate screen printing

letterConstructionRules: Artist name: Monolinear, casual script with long, sweeping horizontal strokes.
Title: Heavy, condensed slab-serif with a slight arc following the roller coaster curve.
Metadata: Small, geometric sans-serif for technical details.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'f' in the script has an elongated crossbar that extends over the entire word.
The slab-serif letters feature 'western' style spurs and heavy vertical weight.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between fluid, airy script and rigid, heavy slab-serif.

preserve: The upward arc of the title

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the mid-century casual script feel.
Matches the heavy, condensed slab-serif aesthetic.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a mid-century style illustration of a carnival at night. The bottom half should be a dense purple fairground with a Ferris wheel and tent silhouettes in black line art. A large roller coaster track should curve upward from the left to the right. Above the track, place three wavy bands of color: green, yellow, and white. The top background is a solid sky blue. In the upper right, place a circular portrait frame with purple and yellow rings.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a casual, monolinear script name in the top left sky area. Add a heavy, condensed slab-serif title in all caps, following the curve of the white band in the center. Add a small technical code in a simple sans-serif in the top right corner.

verificationChecks: Does the roller coaster track divide the composition diagonally?
Is the script lettering monolinear and airy?
Are the color bands following the curve of the track?
Is the fairground detail rendered in high-contrast black line art?

postGenerationChecks: Check that text follows the curve without looking digitally warped.
Ensure the purple fairground area feels dense and textured.
Verify the script and slab-serif fonts do not clash in weight.
Confirm the circular inset is perfectly round.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a dynamic landscape divider (roller coaster) with flat color bands, a circular focal point, and a mix of casual script and heavy display type to create a 1960s pop-culture aesthetic.
